samples.question: The picture shows one dark wall of constant thickness on a plain white background. The wall is a single closed loop: it never branches, never crosses itself and never touches itself, and it never reaches the edge of the picture. Because it is one closed loop it cuts the white background into exactly two parts, an enclosed part sealed off by the wall and an outside part that reaches the edge of the picture. The loop is long and winding, so the enclosed part is a narrow lane rather than a plain blob, and narrow white lanes also occur outside the loop. There are exactly two dots, one orange and one purple, both the same size and both clear of the wall. Exactly one of the two dots is in the enclosed part; the other is in the outside part. A dot is in the outside part when you can travel from it over white background to the edge of the picture without ever crossing the wall. Which dot is the one sealed inside the loop? Answer orange or purple.
